## Summary
- ✅ Implemented COBOL Hello World program that prints exactly "Hello, World!"
- ✅ Added comprehensive GitHub Actions workflow for automated testing
- ✅ Program follows COBOL best practices with proper structure and comments
- ✅ Includes build/run instructions in comments

## Files Added
- `hello.cob` - COBOL program with proper divisions, clear comments, and compilation instructions
- `.github/workflows/test-hello-world.yml` - CI/CD workflow that installs GnuCOBOL, compiles the program, runs it, and verifies output

## Features
- **Program Structure**: Uses standard COBOL divisions (IDENTIFICATION, ENVIRONMENT, DATA, PROCEDURE)
- **Clear Comments**: Explains each section and includes compilation/execution instructions
- **CI/CD Integration**: Automated workflow runs on every push to main and pull requests
- **Output Verification**: Workflow verifies the program outputs exactly "Hello, World!"

## Test Plan
- [x] Program compiles successfully with GnuCOBOL
- [x] Program runs and outputs "Hello, World!" correctly
- [x] GitHub Actions workflow passes all steps
- [x] Output verification logic works correctly
- [x] Code follows COBOL conventions and best practices
